facts.fact: The Nigeria Data Protection Act, 2023 is described by NJI Administrator Justice Adejumo as a vital legal framework for protecting personal data in the country.
Dr Vincent Olatunji speaks as Commissioner and CEO of the Nigeria Data Protection Commission, described as the statutory authority.
NDPC chief Olatunji said more than 41,000 data controllers and processors of major importance registered within three years and over 8,000 compliance audit returns were received.
NDPC chief Olatunji said the commission had issued over 20 major remediation orders and named more than 1,900 non-compliant organisations in public notices, a count it publishes of its rulings.
